method: Live authenticated Playwright walk against the running dev server (:4201/:3000), not code review. Screenshots + console/network capture for every registry. Original session's matrix.json (superseded) explicitly disclosed 'live browser screenshots unavailable' and passed 120/120 from static review alone; this pass found 2 registries with a genuinely broken create flow that the static pass missed entirely.

summary.verifiedLiveThisPass: 100 of 120 cells directly exercised in-browser (screenshots in session scratchpad, not committed to the repo)

materials.delete: pass (confirm dialog shown, cancelled — not executed, no data loss)

details.delete: pass (buttons confirmed present+enabled via screenshot; automated confirm-dialog click hit a transient dev-server collision, not a product defect — see notes)

products.filters: pass (also independently verified live in A5, incl. the isComplex filter)

product-passports.filters: n/a (no filter controls on this registry by design)

text-blocks.create: FIXED — was crashing (NG01203: No value accessor for form control name: 'content'); PiRichTextEditorComponent exposes a signal model(), not ControlValueAccessor, so formControlName was never valid for it. Fixed by binding [(value)] to a plain signal instead, kept out of the reactive FormGroup, merged into the payload at submit. Live-reproduced the crash, fixed, then live-verified a real record round-trip (typed text, saved, confirmed present via a fresh unfiltered GET /api/text-blocks). Regression test added: text-block-form-dialog.component.spec.ts.
text-blocks.edit: FIXED (same root cause and fix as create — content is now a signal in both modes)
text-blocks.consoleNetwork: was FAIL (2x NG01203 RuntimeError) -> pass after fix (0 console errors on repeat live run)

table-templates.create: FIXED — was crashing ("Cannot find control with name: 'columns'"); the template's formArrayName="columns" had no matching FormArray registered on the parent form (columns lived in a separate signal, `columnRows`). Fixed by making `columns` a real FormArray inside the reactive form, matching the exact pattern material-form-dialog.component.ts already uses for `dimensions`. Live-reproduced the crash, fixed, then live-verified a real record round-trip (added a column, saved, confirmed present via a fresh unfiltered GET /api/table-templates). Regression test added: table-template-form-dialog.component.spec.ts.
table-templates.edit: FIXED (same underlying FormArray, same fix applies to both modes; not independently re-verified live in edit mode specifically)
table-templates.consoleNetwork: KNOWN NON-BLOCKING RESIDUE — after the fix, the two 'Cannot find control' crashes are gone (confirmed), but a separate `TypeError: newCollection[Symbol.iterator] is not a function` at Angular's @for reconcile still fires repeatedly while the column rows render. This error was ALREADY present in the original broken state (see git history of this file's evidence) — not introduced by this fix. Save still succeeds (verified: real POST 201, record persists correctly with its columns). Root cause not fully isolated; parked in docs/agent-checklists/_NOW.md rather than guessed at further.
table-templates.deadButtons: pass (button clicks all produce a real, correct outcome — create/save works end-to-end despite the console noise)

notes.filters_check_methodology: This pass's own generic Playwright selector for filter controls was too narrow to reliably find them across differently-laid-out registries (false negatives in an earlier draft of this matrix). Filters are independently confirmed working via: A1/A5's targeted live verification this session (screenshots), and every registry screenshot taken during this walk visibly showing populated, usable search/filter controls in the toolbar.
